ns2:course.label: Term Structure Models
ns2:course.description: Extensive coverage of several models of the term structure of interest rates, including their implementation, calibration, and use in valuing interest rate derivatives. Will include applications of both Monte Carlo methods and finite-difference or "tree" methods. Approved for letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: FIN 500 and FIN 512, or equivalents.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: FIN 500 and FIN 512, or equivalents.
